summary: Fiserv Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an underwriting agreement for a public offering of €500 million 3.750% Senior Notes due 2030 and €500 million 4.250% Senior Notes due 2034. The offering is expected to close June 23, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No deal terms beyond the principal amounts and interest rates are provided; the filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category.
